title: Configuring Business Continuity in Zscaler Client Connector

blocks.text: Business Continuity in Private Access (ZPA) allows users to continue to access applications during Private Access-related cloud outages or Internet Service Provider (ISP) outages. You can configure Business Continuity in Zscaler Client Connector so that both enrolled and new users can connect to a Private Cloud during an outage.
To learn more, see About Business Continuity.
Business Continuity is available only for Zscaler Client Connector version 4.6 and later for Windows and for Zscaler Client Connector version 4.7 and later for macOS.

If Business Continuity is enabled, enrolled users automatically access the Private Cloud if there is an outage and continue to have access to their applications based on their app profile. During the outage, the Update App and Update Policy options are not available in the About section of the More window in Zscaler Client Connector.

You can also enroll new users in Zscaler Client Connector and provide access to applications during the outage even though the Zscaler Admin Console and the cloud are unavailable or if users experience authentication issues or upstream communication failures (e.g., DNS exceptions, connection timeouts, or socket unreachable) during enrollment..

Before an outage, you must download a configuration file with Business Continuity settings and a public key. You can pass the file and public key to Zscaler Client Connector in an installer option. If you use Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later for Windows, you can also pass an installer option that enables Business Continuity if users experience network or authentication issues during enrollment.

The app can then authenticate with the Private Cloud and apply a stored app profile to the user to provide application access. The stored app profile from the configuration file is used until the Zscaler back-end servers can retrieve the config profile.

blocks.item: Ensure that the Business Continuity settings are configured.
Enable Configure ZPA Business Continuity in the app profile.
Download the config file and copy the thumbprint from the Business Continuity page.

blocks.heading: Enrolling a New User During an Outage

blocks.text: To enroll a new user during a Private Access-related cloud outage or Internet Service Provider (ISP) outage, install Zscaler Client Connector using an MDM or GPO and pass the downloaded configuration file and the public key. Optionally, install Zscaler Client Connector with Business Continuity enabled for network and authentication failures (Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later for Windows). To learn more, see Supported Parameters for Zscaler Client Connector for Windows.

blocks.heading: Upgrading Zscaler Client Connector While in Business Continuity Mode

blocks.text: If a device using a Zscaler Client Connector for Windows version earlier than 5.0 is in Business Continuity mode when the upgrade process starts and is still in Business Continuity mode after upgrading to Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later for Windows, the user must reauthenticate to Private Access after the upgrade.
